university: The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
department_or_school: Department of Nutrition, Gillings School of Global Public Health
spring_2027_deadline: Generally no spring entry: Graduate School program page says 'Only in unusual circumstances and after consultation with department is Spring or Summer admission considered' (https://gradschool.sites.unc.edu/nutrition)
fall_2027_deadline: 2027-01-12 (Fall 2027, per Gillings 'How to Apply' page https://sph.unc.edu/students/how-to-apply/; department PhD page still shows prior cycle: priority Dec 16, 2025 / final Jan 13, 2026)
funding_deadline_note: Prior cycle had a priority/fellowship-recommended date of Dec 16, 2025 before the Jan 13, 2026 final deadline; a 2026 priority date was not seen - apply by mid-December 2026 to be safe. Not verified for 2027.
ielts_subscore_note: UNC Graduate School minimum IELTS 7 overall; IELTS One-Skill Retake not accepted; scores must be no more than 2 years old. Exemption applies to applicants from countries where English is the sole official language, or with a degree from a university where English is the sole language of instruction; whether a Pakistani degree qualifies is Not verified.
toefl_min: TOEFL iBT 90 (tests before Jan 26, 2026) or 5 on new scale (tests on/after Jan 26, 2026); Duolingo 110
funding_summary: PhD page: offers typically guarantee at least two years of tuition, student fees, health insurance, and a stipend at the NIH recommended minimum; most Nutrition doctoral students are funded throughout their program. Admission is largely based on a match with a faculty member willing to provide funding.
notes: Applicant's IELTS 6.5 is BELOW the UNC Graduate School minimum of 7.0 - she would need to retake IELTS (or use TOEFL/Duolingo meeting the minimum). Faculty match required before admission.

university: The University of North Carolina at Greensboro
department_or_school: Department of Nutrition, School of Health and Human Sciences
spring_2027_deadline: November 15 (spring admission, department page; assumed to be 2026-11-15 for Spring 2027). Graduate School advises international applicants to apply at least 30 days before the departmental deadline (i.e., by about 2026-10-16). Applications are not reviewed until a course-by-course credential evaluation (NACES) is received.
fall_2027_deadline: February 1 (fall admission WITH assistantship consideration); non-assistantship fall deadline listed as May 15 on the department page but May 1 on www.uncg.edu/degrees - sources conflict
funding_deadline_note: Feb 1 is the deadline for assistantship consideration for fall admission. No assistantship statement was seen for spring entry.
ielts_subscore_note: Graduate School: IELTS 6.5 band minimum; scores no more than 2 years old.
funding_summary: Department financial-support page: PhD stipends beginning at $16,150 (9 months) for three years if entering with an MS thesis degree, or four years if entering with a BS. Graduate manual (2019): tuition waivers are assigned separately from stipends, so a student may receive a stipend but not a waiver; out-of-state waivers may be available. Figures may be dated.
notes: IELTS 6.5 meets the minimum. Spring entry exists (Nov 15). Department dates differ slightly between ntr.uncg.edu and www.uncg.edu pages - confirm with the program. Start the NACES course-by-course evaluation immediately if targeting Spring 2027.

department_or_school: Interdepartmental Graduate Program in Nutrition, College of Agriculture and Life Sciences
spring_2027_deadline: International spring deadline is July 15 (catalog) - the Spring 2027 international deadline (2026-07-15) has PASSED. US spring deadline Nov 25.
fall_2027_deadline: March 1 (international, Fall; catalog) - presumably 2027-03-01; US June 25. Graduate School: submit by the Graduate School or program deadline, whichever is earlier.

ielts_subscore_note: IELTS 6.5 overall. NC State search results also stated a minimum of 6.5 in EACH section and 7.0 speaking for TA appointments, but whether the per-section rule is the Graduate School's or a single department's was not confirmed. Applicant's subscores are unknown - check that every band is >= 6.5.
toefl_min: TOEFL iBT 80 with 18 per section (pre-2026 scale); new 2026 scale total 4 with 4 per section; Duolingo 110 (one page lists 120)
funding_summary: Catalog: assistantships and fellowships are awarded competitively by the department where the faculty advisor is based; admission does not guarantee support; applicants seeking funding should contact potential advisors directly. Graduate School requires GPA >= 3.0 for assistantships.
notes: Applicants are not recommended for admission until they have secured a research faculty advisor who provides a written endorsement to the program director. Entrance exam: None. Requires one biology and one organic chemistry course.
